content: The sun never boasts of its radiant warmth; it simply shines and warms the world.
author: Persian Proverbs
explanation: The rooster crows loudly at dawn, claiming he brought the morning light. The sun rises in majestic, wordless silence, pouring life, heat, and photosynthesis over the entire planet without demanding a single bill or monument. Emulate the sun: shine without advertising.
practicalInsight: Do your work with excellence today with zero need to tell anyone about it. Let the warmth be felt.
reflectionPrompt: Why do you feel the urge to announce your goodness to the world, instead of simply being good?
